references.text: Psalm 41:1-3 speaks of the blessing of caring for the weak, which is similar to the act of giving a cup of cold water to one of the least in Matthew 10:42.
Hebrews 6:10 notes that God is not unjust so as to forget the work and love shown in his name by serving the saints, paralleling the reward mentioned in Matthew 10:42 for serving even the least.
Matthew 25:40 emphasizes that serving the least is like serving Christ himself, which resonates with the message in Matthew 10:42 about giving to the least.
Isaiah 58:7-10 calls for sharing with those in need and helping the oppressed, reflecting the act of mercy in Matthew 10:42.
Luke 14:13-14 speaks of inviting the poor and disabled, promising that one will be rewarded, which is similar to the reward for serving the least in Matthew 10:42.
